taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

allometry.note: 1 m at 12 years in the open, the middle of Flora of China's 50-150 cm. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: The leaf card's petiole share, from Flora of China's petioles 0.5-2 cm on blades 6-20 cm (the middles, 1.25 of 14.25 cm): short-stalked leaves.

traits.life_span.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 132, Sarcandra glabra (read 2026-10-16): evergreen subshrubs.

traits.leaf_habit.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 132, Sarcandra glabra (read 2026-10-16): evergreen subshrubs.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 132, Sarcandra glabra (read 2026-10-16): 50-150 cm tall.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 132, Sarcandra glabra (read 2026-10-16): 50-150 cm tall; the top of that range.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 132, Sarcandra glabra (read 2026-10-16): blades 6-20 by 2-8 cm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 132, Sarcandra glabra (read 2026-10-16): blades 6-20 by 2-8 cm.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 132, Sarcandra glabra (read 2026-10-16): petioles 0.5-2 cm.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 132, Sarcandra glabra (read 2026-10-16): blades elliptic or ovate to ovate-lanceolate, or broadly elliptic to oblong; elliptic the first named.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 132, Sarcandra glabra (read 2026-10-16): inflorescences terminal, usually branched, more or less in spikes.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 132, Sarcandra glabra (read 2026-10-16): inflorescences 1.5-4 cm with their peduncles.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 132, Sarcandra glabra (read 2026-10-16): flowers yellowish green; the RGB is the authors' rendering of the word.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 132, Sarcandra glabra (read 2026-10-16): drupes globose, 3-4 mm across, or ovoid, about 4 mm.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 132, Sarcandra glabra (read 2026-10-16): drupes shiny red or yellowish red when ripe; the RGB is the authors' rendering of shiny red.

traits.flowering_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as Flora of China gives no months.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as Flora of China gives no months.

traits.leaf_colour.note: A dark, glossy green, the median over each photograph of its green, saturated pixels, then the median over the photographs, in 15 photographs of living plants in iNaturalist research-grade observations 71688619, 101079448, 137144714, 150740140, 238222097, 331395152, 333579646, 383595008 (CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA).

traits.bark_colour.note: The stems stay green to the base, swollen at the nodes, a yellowish green read from the stem's pixels in observation 383595008 and seen in 137144714 and 331395152.

traits.rosette.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2484645), as no source read gives it.
